_comment: Deployment settings for the hxd-ng web client. Edit this file next to index.html; no rebuild is needed. Every key is optional.
_defaultServer: The ng listener the connect form starts from. Omit it, or leave it empty, to derive ws://<the host that served this page>:5700 — which is right for the usual case of the client sitting in front of its own server.
_servers: Extra addresses offered as suggestions in the form.
_title: The tab title before a server names itself.
title: Hotline
_allowCustomServer: false hides the server field: one deployment, one server.
